PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES
  MAY 20, 2025, 5:30 PM
  REGULAR MEETING

Commissioners Present: Chair Larry Giannone, Commissioner Karol Curtis, Commissioner
Patrick Jones, Commissioner Ruth Luevand, Commissioner Orlando Pimentel, Commissioner
Greg Tober

Commission Members Absent: Vice Chair Bob Olander

City/Sheriff Representatives: City Manager Brad McKinney, Assistant City Manager Travis Sais,
Public Works Director Shari Garwick, Acting Captain of Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department
San Dimas Station, Louis Serrano, Acting Captain of Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department
Transit Services Bureau, Brian Jones

Call to Order: 5:30 PM

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
  Chair Larry Giannone noted Commissioner
  Bob Olander is not present, but he has an
  excused absence. Chair Giannone also noted
  he has some documents to read on
  Commissioner Olander’s behalf later in the
  meeting.
 BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 BI.1 Approval of Minutes for January 21,  MOTION: Motion/seconded by Commissioner
 2025, Public Safety Commission Meeting  Patrick Jones/Commissioner Ruth Luevand
  to approve the minutes of January 21, 2025.
  Motion carried 6-0.

  Yes: Giannone, Curtis, Jones, Luevand,
  Pimentel, Tober
  No: None
  Absent: Olander
  Abstain: None
 REPORTS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 R1. Commission Reports  Commissioner Curtis reported no significant
  issues or increased sightings of homeless
  individuals since relocating her office.

  Commissioner Luevand requested a
  discussion regarding the potential impacts of
  Assembly Bill (AB) 413 on San Dimas.
 Approve Minutes of May 20, 2025 Public Safety Commission Meeting  Page 2
For the Meeting of September 16, 2025

  Commissioner Pimentel expressed
  anticipation for the Gold Line and tonight's
  meeting. Commissioner Pimentel also noted
  questions about increased traffic on Eucla
  Avenue, suggesting it can be discussed at a
  later time.
 R2. City Staff Reports  Los Angeles County Sherriff's Department
  (LASD) Report:
  Acting Captain Serrano reported an overall
  5.5% reduction in Part 1 crimes in 2024. As
  of May 19, 2025, Part 1 crimes are down
  38% year-to-date, with assaults specifically
  down 21%. Robberies have also decreased
  significantly, from 18 at this time last year to 2
  year-to-date in 2025. Burglaries and grand
  thefts are also down. Captain Serrano also
  highlighted a 54% increase in LASD
  recruitment efforts. Looking ahead, LASD is
  preparing for the following upcoming events:
  2026 World Cup, 2027 Super Bowl, and 2028
  LA Olympics.

  City Manager's Report:
  City Manager McKinney announced that the
  Pomona Fairplex will be the venue for Cricket
  during the LA County Olympics, which may
  lead to increased traffic. Discussions are
  ongoing regarding Bonelli Park as a potential
  venue for Mountain Biking. The L.A. CADA
  team is now in the City five days a week. The
  City is also collaborating with the Sheriff's
  Community Action Team (CAT) and Caltrans
  on encampment cleanup efforts.

  Public Works Department Update:
  Public Works Director Shari Garwick
  addressed AB 413, clarifying that the
  California Vehicle Code already addresses
  and enforces violations without the need for
  red curb. However, red curbs have been
  installed at many of the schools, and
  enforcement is ongoing. In response to
  Commissioner Luevand's question about
  potential increased bus and train traffic due to
  the Metro line, Director Garwick stated that
  traffic engineering is involved in ongoing
  education about these restrictions. Director
  Garwick noted that staff will analyze traffic
  patterns to determine if additional signage is
  necessary to improve pedestrian safety and
 Approve Minutes of May 20, 2025 Public Safety Commission Meeting  Page 3
For the Meeting of September 16, 2025

  driver awareness around the Metro line. City
  Manager McKinney added that this will be
  assessed as the impact becomes clearer.

 NEW BUSINESS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 NB1. Public Safety Planning for Metro San  City Preparedness for the Foothill Gold
 Dimas Station Opening  Line Extension:
  Assistant City Manager Travis Sais, City
  Manager Brad McKinney, and Public Works
  Director Shari Garwick presented on the
  City's five-year preparedness efforts for the
  Foothill Gold Line extension and answered
  Commissioners’ questions.

  Chair Giannone read comments from Vice
  Chair Bob Olander into the record regarding
  the City's parking management plan.

  Transit Safety Presentations:
  Acting Captain Brian Jones of the Los
  Angeles County Sheriff's Department's
  Transit Services Bureau presented the A-Line
  public safety plan and its dedicated
  resources.

  Los Angeles Metro Deputy Chief of System
  Security and Law Enforcement, Robert
  Gummer, provided an overview of Metro's
  deployed services and resources.

  Both Acting Captain Jones and Deputy Chief
  Gummer answered the Commissioners’
  questions.

Adjourned: 7:02 PM

I, Travis Sais, Assistant City Manager, attest that these minutes are accurate and reflective of
the actions taken by the Public Safety Commission.

_______________________________
Travis Sais, Assistant City Manager
